response.justification: While Bogdan possesses extensive software engineering experience, strong architectural skills, and a proven track record of mentoring and technical leadership, he falls significantly short of the mandatory 8 years of C++ programming experience. His career has primarily focused on web technologies, TypeScript, Node.js, and Dlang, rather than the low-level compute infrastructure, networking, and C++ development required for this specialized cloud platform role.
strengths: Strong background in software craftsmanship, TDD, and establishing engineering best practices.
Demonstrated technical leadership and mentoring through workshops, dojos, and open-source contributions.
Experience building and scaling distributed systems and event-driven architectures.
concerns: Severely lacks the required 8 years of professional C++ programming experience.
Background leans heavily towards full-stack and product engineering rather than deep cloud compute infrastructure.
Limited explicit experience managing or architecting lower-level network, storage, or hardware compute layers.
